init.title: Solar Fusion – Settings
init.description: Sources, entities and PV sensors can be changed via **Reconfigure** in the menu of this entry.

data.exclusion_factor: Exclusion threshold k (× RMSE of the best source)
data.shading_apply: Apply learned shading to the forecast
data.horizon_sources: Sources that already include a horizon profile

data_description.exclusion_factor: A source whose RMSE exceeds k times that of the best source gets weight 0. It keeps being evaluated and returns on its own. Default: 2.0.
data_description.min_eval_days: Until a source has this many evaluated days, all sources are weighted equally. Default: 7.
data_description.shading_learn: Learns a correction factor per sun position (azimuth × elevation) from hourly production versus the 06:00 forecast. Uses only days with a stable ratio in the high-sun hours, so clouds do not count as shading. Default: off.
data_description.shading_apply: Multiplies every source's hours by the learned factor before weighting. Has no effect until cells are learned, so enabling learning is enough. Turn off to inspect the learned map first without changing the forecast.
data_description.horizon_sources: These sources are neither corrected nor used for learning, e.g. Open-Meteo with use_horizon enabled. Prevents double correction.

take_snapshot.name: Take Morning Snapshot
take_snapshot.description: Manually triggers the 06:00 morning forecast snapshot for all Solar Fusion instances. Useful after initial setup or a late restart to initialise accuracy tracking without waiting until the next morning.

learn_shading.name: Learn shading from recorder
learn_shading.description: Learns the shading map retroactively: rebuilds the 06:00 hourly forecast of each source from the recorder history (only sources whose hourly attribute is recorded, e.g. Open-Meteo; not Solcast) and the hourly production from long-term statistics. Only reaches back as far as the recorder keeps state history (default 10 days).

days.name: Days
days.description: How many past days to reconstruct.

repair_history.name: Repair history
repair_history.description: Re-reads actual PV production from the Home Assistant recorder and corrects stored actual values in the history (e.g. after the utility-meter carryover bug). Runs automatically at startup; call it manually to repair a specific date range.

date_from.name: From date
date_from.description: First date to repair. Defaults to the earliest history entry.

date_to.name: To date
date_to.description: Last date to repair. Defaults to the latest history entry.

legacy_card_resource.title: Old Solar Fusion card resource
legacy_card_resource.description:
The Solar Fusion card now ships with the integration and is loaded automatically. The dashboard resource {url} from the former HACS card (hass-solar-fusion-card) is no longer needed.

1. In HACS, uninstall **Solar Fusion Card**.
2. Under **Settings → Dashboards → ⋮ → Resources**, remove {url} if it is still listed.
3. Reload the browser.

Your cards (`type: custom:solar-fusion-card`) keep working unchanged.
